task: B01-LOCK: proposed keyring LOCK/UNLOCK contract for key erasure before S3 (prerequisite of H05-T5d), design only
summary: 43/100 unchanged. A design contract (docs/implementation/B01-KEYRING-LOCK.md, ADR-KEYRING-LOCK-20261126) inventories the key material live at SUSPEND on main fb4a40fa, separates the kernel-verifiable fact instance erased from the custody fact no unwrap path, and specifies an init-only LOCK by kernel teardown of the Key Service, the SUSPEND precondition, UNLOCK requirements and ten acceptance cases.
